query: I’m evaluating an 83-year-old man with sepsis. Among male ICU patients aged 78–88 with sepsis, what percentile rank does an instability score of 85 in the first 24 hours have? Also report mean ICU LOS and hospital mortality for quartile 4.
final_sql: SELECT (microbiologyevents.instability_score - lag(microbiologyevents.instability_score) OVER (PARTITION BY icustays.subject_id ORDER BY chartevents.charttime)) / NULLIF((q3 - q1), 0) AS percentile_rank, AVG(icustays.los) AS average_los, COUNT(*) filter (WHERE deathtime IS NOT NULL) AS mortality_rate FROM male_icu_patients JOIN quartiles ON TRUE JOIN mortality ON TRUE WHERE microbiologyevents.instability_score IS NOT NULL AND lag(microbiologyevents.instability_score) OVER (PARTITION BY icustays.subject_id ORDER BY chartevents.charttime) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY percentile_rank, average_los, mortality_rate;
